join_contract.rationale: Join one successful lead event to its governed commercial outcome without sending name, email, phone, free text or a durable cross-session identity to Analytics.

source_of_truth.rule: GA4 never certifies qualification, conversion or settled revenue.

freeze_contract.rationale: Use only daily GA4 tables outside the normal late-arrival update window before freezing.

label_definition.positive: latest terminal lifecycle stage is close_convert_lead
label_definition.negative: latest terminal lifecycle stage is close_unconvert_lead or disqualify_lead
label_definition.unresolved: all non-terminal stages are excluded from supervised training

evaluation_contract.split: predeclared temporal train/holdout; no random split
evaluation_contract.challenger_rule: A more complex model cannot advance unless it shows reproducible incremental value over the simpler preregistered baseline on the frozen holdout.
evaluation_contract.uncertainty: Report metric uncertainty and class counts; do not promote from a point estimate alone.
evaluation_contract.dnn_gate: Blocked until labeled sample size, stability and incremental-value gates justify complexity.

shadow_contract.output: Persist prediction plus model revision and later reconcile with outcome for evaluation only.

current_decision.reason: GA4 real activity is present; BigQuery export evidence and terminal labels are not yet certified.
